# Note sources, by page

Every note on every `R_`, `F_` and `C_` page, in site order, with the sources it cites and where in each source the supporting text most likely is.

**How locations were found:** each cited source text in `scratch/` was searched automatically for the passage whose wording best overlaps the note. The location is a best guess, not a verified citation. The match % is how much of the note's distinctive wording appears in that passage; anything marked **⚠ weak** (under 40%) and shows the runner-up passage too needs a manual check. `file:line` points into the `scratch/` copy of the source. RulesPal entries marked NOT USED were penalised but can still appear if nothing else matched.

Sources: **1** Living Rules Reference v2.0; **2** RulesPal TI4 FAQ (community consensus and designer rulings); **3** Learn to Play; **4** The Unofficially Official FAQ and Errata (PoK v3.1.1); **5** Compiled Designer Rulings (2018–2019); **6** Rules-as-Written & Community Consensus Rulings (unofficial); **7** Thunder’s Edge Rulebook; **8** Prophecy of Kings Rulebook; **9** Designer Q&A; **10** Twilight Codex Vol. I; **11** Twilight Codex Vol. IV: Liberation; **12** Twilight Codex Vol. III: Vigil; **13** Thunder’s Edge revised strategy cards (card text as transcribed on the Twilight Imperium Wiki); **14** Twilight Codex Vol. II: Affinity; **15** Codex 4.5 Technology Card Updates. **\*** = no source found.

**Totals:** 2661 notes; 2345 source citations located (278 weak matches); 974 unsourced (\*); 0 with no citation marker.

- **2** Abilities that trigger “at the start of a combat”, other than those on agents, can only be resolved during a combat in which the player resolving them is participating.

    > Q: Can abilities that trigger “at the start of a combat” be played in combats you are not participating in? A: No, any non-agent “at the start of a combat” abilities must be played during a combat you are participating in.
- **3** A player only wins a combat if a space combat or ground combat occurred. Destroying all opposing ships with the Space Cannon ability, destroying all opposing ground forces with the Bombardment ability, landing ground forces on a planet without opposing ground forces, or the opposing player avoiding the combat with the Naalu player’s Foresight faction ability does not count as winning a combat. A planet containing only another player’s structures does not cause a ground combat.

#### Oceanbound

- **1** Ocean cards are spent as though they were planet cards. However, oceans are not planets, and do not count as planets for the purpose of scoring objectives, such as Push Boundaries.
  - **[6] Rules-as-Written & Community Consensus Rulings (unofficial)** — Q: What are the Ocean cards exactly? Do they count as planets for scoring purposes (i.e. P (`06_RAW_and_Community_Consensus_Rulings.txt:660`, match 63%)
    > Q: What are the Ocean cards exactly? Do they count as planets for scoring purposes (i.e. Push Boundaries)? Can you vote using their influence? A: Oceans do not count as planets for scoring. They may be spent as planet cards.
- **2** If all of the Deepwrought player’s ocean cards are already in play, they cannot resolve Oceanbound to ready one of their oceans.

#### Visionaria Select (Breakthrough)

- **1** When Visionaria Select is exhausted, all other players have the opportunity to participate; the Deepwrought player does not choose which players will participate.
  - **\*** no source found
- **2** The researching player chooses which promissory note they give to the Deepwrought player.
  - **\*** no source found
- **3** Giving a promissory note because of Visionaria Select is not resolving a transaction.
  - **\*** no source found
- **4** If the Deepwrought player already owns a technology that a participating player researches, then the Deepwrought player will not gain a technology.
  - **\*** no source found
- **5** If the Nekro player participates, they will gain three command tokens. The Deepwrought player will not gain a technology this way.
  - **\*** no source found

#### Age of Commerce

- **2** The Hacan player’s Guild Ships faction ability and Trade Convoys promissory note provide no benefit while playing with the Age of Commerce event. However, Trade Convoys may still be played as a component action.
  - **\*** no source found
- **3** If the Empyrean player receives commodities from a player with their Dark Pact promissory note in their play area equal to that player’s printed commodity value, then both players will gain one trade good. This need not be all of the giving player’s current commodities.
  - **\*** no source found

  - **\*** no source found
- **5** A player may share any number of technologies in a single transaction.
  - **\*** no source found

  - **\*** no source found
